text:
maria: Quick heads up — PR #342 (docs: SDK migration + example updates) is ready for review but the Vercel preview is returning 403s for images served through the image proxy. Need approvals and a green preview to merge in today's 17:00 PT deploy window. Anyone available? :eyes:

jordan: I can take a look. Do you have the preview link?

maria: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/pr-342/preview — page loads but screenshots are missing. Console shows 403s for /_next/image requests. Sample error: ```
GET https://vercel.com/_next/image?url=https://assets.example.com/guide.png 403
Error: Image optimization blocked by external domain
```

sam: :thinking: that usually means next/image remotePatterns or allowed domains aren't configured for preview builds. Our docs site is mkdocs-produced, but the preview runs a tiny Next wrapper to proxy images. Did we forget to set NEXT_IMAGE_DOMAINS for preview env?

lee: We only configured remotePatterns in next.config.js for production. The preview env variables live in the Vercel project settings — looks like NEXT_IMAGE_DOMAINS is set for production but not for preview. I can open a tiny PR to add the host to vercel.json so previews get the same rule.

chris: If lee pushes the config change, Vercel will redeploy the preview automatically. That should regenerate the images.

vercel-bot: Deployment queued for commit abc123def -> preview: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/pr-342/preview (will update once build completes)

maria: Perfect. Also need a content reviewer: @jordan for accuracy and @sam for the code snippet checks. If both approvals land by 16:30 PT we can merge before the 17:00 slot.

jordan: On it. Quick sanity note: the migration example currently says `pip install redwood==1.4.2` — we should recommend `pip install \"redwood>=2.0\"` instead, since 2.x has the new API. I'll leave an inline suggestion.

sam: I'll run a local smoke test on the snippets. My local quick commands for folks who can't run the full container: `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && mkdocs build -f mkdocs.yml && npx serve site -p 8000` — served fine for me and the examples execute. If anyone wants I can paste console output.

maria: Thanks — please paste if you see anything weird. @lee ping me when the vercel config PR is up so I can watch for the redeploy. If the 403s persist, fallback plan is to merge with images pointing at the CDN domain that Netlify accepts and follow up with a config-only PR to fix preview image proxying.

lee: Opening PR now (small vercel.json tweak adding remotePatterns). ETA ~10–15m, then I'll ping vercel-bot.

chris: Note for release notes: add "docs: updated SDK migration example to v2" to the PR description so release engineer can pick it up.

maria: Copy — I'll update the PR description and hold merge until we have two approvals and a green preview. Thanks everyone :rocket:
